description_full: Pattern Group Inc. operates as an e-commerce accelerator that combines proprietary technology and on-demand expertise to support consumer brands operating across e-commerce marketplaces in the United States and internationally. The company acquires inventory from brand partners to sell to consumers in various industries, including health and wellness; beauty and personal care; home and lifestyle; pet; sports and outdoors; and consumer electronics. The company was formerly known as Covalent Group, Inc. and changed its name to Pattern Group Inc. in November 2024. Pattern Group Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Lehi, Utah.

financial_summary: Pattern Group Inc. - Series A is a mid-cap consumer cyclical business with a $3.6B market cap on $2.5B of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $79M in free cash flow — roughly 3 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 6.12× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 3.7% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 49% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.1× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
